subject: Service Maintenance Notification
body_plain:
Dear Valued Customer,

We will be performing scheduled maintenance on our cloud services this weekend (October 11-12, 2025). During this time, some services may experience brief interruptions.

Maintenance Window: Saturday 2:00 AM - Sunday 6:00 AM UTC

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our support team.

Thank you for your understanding,
CloudService Support Team
